title: Area of Sector and Segment — Areas Related to Circles
hook: Let's explore Area of Sector and Segment from the chapter on Areas Related to Circles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Area of Sector and Segment A sector is a 'slice' of a circle; a segment is the region between a chord and its arc. Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr², and segment area = sector area − triangle area. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr
💡 Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr²
💡 Area of segment = Area of sector − Area of triangle
💡 Major sector + Minor sector = Full circle
